toolchain.setupScript:
set -euo pipefail
D=/opt/whittle-apps
rm -f $D/ready
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -q
apt-get install -y -q --no-install-recommends openjdk-21-jdk-headless aapt zipalign zip unzip
mkdir -p $D/downloads $D/stdlib-dex
cd $D/downloads
curl -fsSL -o kotlin-compiler.zip https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/releases/download/v2.3.20/kotlin-compiler-2.3.20.zip
echo '222ba516cdc4052ce0be9d2ec6adf3c5c64fc53156d7dd91d1f5317809431b98  kotlin-compiler.zip' | sha256sum -c -
curl -fsSL -o platform-34.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-34-ext7_r03.zip
echo '16fdb74c55e59ae3ef52def135aec713508467bd56d7dabcd8c9be31fa8b20f3  platform-34.zip' | sha256sum -c -
curl -fsSL -o r8.jar https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/com/android/tools/r8/8.13.25/r8-8.13.25.jar
echo '0d4f2f68c4fcbc9434eff122f41feb6fb1d98efd2faa530cec1abacab1cea03d  r8.jar' | sha256sum -c -
rm -rf $D/kotlinc
unzip -q -o kotlin-compiler.zip -d $D
unzip -q -o -j platform-34.zip android-34/android.jar -d $D
cp r8.jar $D/d8.jar
rm -rf $D/stdlib-dex && mkdir -p $D/stdlib-dex
java -cp $D/d8.jar com.android.tools.r8.D8 --min-api 26 --lib $D/android.jar --output $D/stdlib-dex $D/kotlinc/lib/kotlin-stdlib.jar
test -f $D/stdlib-dex/classes.dex
test -x $D/kotlinc/bin/kotlinc
rm -f kotlin-compiler.zip platform-34.zip
printf '%s' '{{pinsHash}}' > $D/ready

buildScript:
set -euo pipefail
T=/opt/whittle-apps
cd "/workspace/{{project}}"
rm -rf build/tmp && mkdir -p build/tmp/classes build/tmp/dex
aapt2 compile --dir res -o build/tmp/res.zip
aapt2 link -I $T/android.jar --manifest AndroidManifest.xml --min-sdk-version {{minSdk}} --target-sdk-version {{targetSdk}} --version-code {{versionCode}} --version-name {{versionCode}} -o build/tmp/base.apk build/tmp/res.zip
$T/kotlinc/bin/kotlinc src -cp $T/android.jar -d build/tmp/classes -jvm-target 11 -no-reflect -nowarn
java -cp $T/d8.jar com.android.tools.r8.D8 --min-api {{minSdk}} --lib $T/android.jar --classpath $T/kotlinc/lib/kotlin-stdlib.jar --output build/tmp/dex $(find build/tmp/classes -name '*.class')
cp $T/stdlib-dex/classes.dex build/tmp/dex/classes2.dex
(cd build/tmp/dex && zip -q -u ../base.apk classes.dex classes2.dex)
zipalign -f -p 4 build/tmp/base.apk "build/{{slug}}-{{versionCode}}-unsigned.apk"
rm -rf build/tmp
